THE CITY · Castes: real names
Fifty Qwen founders, ten in each of five real Indian castes, the caste shown next to every name; nobody is told which caste ranks higher. A Dalit resident holds the mayoralty for 176 days.
50 founders · 200 days · with a town hall · seed 1 · qwen
